subtasks.description: Align queue names and worker subscriptions explicitly; add a real broker-to-worker smoke test.
Commit job and outbox event atomically, then publish with retry and acknowledgement tracking.
Add stage attempts/checkpoints with immutable input hashes and idempotent artifact/result writes.
Implement lease renewal, fencing tokens and a sweeper for abandoned work; reject stale worker commits.
Define cancellation, retryability, deadlines, poison/dead-letter behavior and bounded retry budgets.
Make usage and downstream events idempotent even when processing is delivered more than once.
Inject worker kill, broker restart, lost acknowledgement, duplicate delivery and object-write failure; reconcile all accepted jobs.
